info.title: WIPS Storage API
info.description:
Documented from routes/api.php, controllers, middleware, models and configuration in wips-storage. Production origin: https://storage.rosebakeshop.net (supplied by owner, deployment unverified). Change baseUrl if needed, without /api or a trailing slash, or select the local server. No live storage changes were made.

### Quick start
1. Log in at POST /api/auth/login (or register an account).
2. Copy token into Authorize (without Bearer).
3. Create a bucket and save data.id.
4. Upload multipart file to that bucket (private by default).
5. Use returned data.id to get metadata or issue a private-url; download its returned url before expiry. For public uploads use data.public_url.
6. Create a scoped token for your backend integration and keep it private.

Owner-scoped resources return 404 for other users. This is a Laravel HTTP API, not an AWS S3 wire-protocol endpoint. API credentials are separate from documentation Basic Auth and Keycloak/SMS tokens. Configuration limits described here are defaults and may differ in deployment.

post.description: Creates a user and a full-ability api token. Token expiry defaults to 1440 minutes, configurable with SANCTUM_DEFAULT_TOKEN_MINUTES. Email must be unique. Auth routes share a 10 requests/minute per-IP limit.

get.summary: Get backup status and recent exports
get.description: Requires authenticated account ID in BACKUP_ADMIN_USER_IDS and a token with literal * ability; narrowly scoped tokens cannot export the installation. Returns up to 20 recent exports, availability flags, storage totals, pending files and optional manual Drive folder link. No automatic Drive upload.

post.description: Requires authenticated account ID in BACKUP_ADMIN_USER_IDS and a token with literal * ability; narrowly scoped tokens cannot export the installation. Rate: 2/minute. ZIP is AES-256 encrypted incremental upload backup; SQL is not encrypted. Successful preparation returns a signed 10-minute download URL. Backups are manual and can take time. Configuration and disk space are required.
